title: Listening Drill — Community orchestra auditions — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Community orchestra auditions — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on community orchestra auditions last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with last-minute changes. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: missing stand.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of room number so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow sheet music instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the audition coordinator before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Sunday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
